findings.claim: `tokio/src/runtime/blocking/pool.rs` changes idle-thread counting state in a way that may affect blocking-pool concurrency ordering.
supporting_facts: Semantic diff detected direct concurrency-ordering changes around `is_counted_idle`: declaration, assignment to `false`, and conditional use.
The same production file changed alongside tests, but the evidence does not prove the tests cover this ordering path.
History context notes a recent bugfix in this area involving `num_idle_threads`, which increases review relevance but is not standalone proof.
findings.limitation: This is based only on explicit scanned concurrency-ordering patterns, not full semantic execution analysis.
findings.review_action: Review wakeup, shutdown, and completion ordering around idle counting; require focused concurrency regression coverage.
